lines.text: Many learners say: I study hard for pass the exam.
Better: I study hard to pass the exam.
To show why you do something, use to plus verb.
To buy! I went to the store to buy milk.

data.wrong: I study hard for pass the exam.
data.right: I study hard to pass the exam.
data.why: To show why you do something, use to plus verb.
